about: Edits made on the player's PC, each Play, to Kino's own scripts dumped from their zombie_theater.ff. Each inserts one line at an anchor (a regular expression matched once). The edited copies go into mod.ff, which Black Ops loads over the stock ones (the way script mods for stock maps work).

columns.anchor: regular expression (Go syntax) that must match exactly once
columns.required: true = stop and log if the anchor is missing
columns.tested_in_game: true once seen working in Kino

rows.source: zombie_theater.gsc main() calls maps\_zombiemode::main() after include_weapons()
same call; runs once Black Ops' weapon tables exist
zombie_theater.csc mirrors the server include_weapons() for the Mystery Box display
